title: Prove sharper continuation backing for the selected coefficient evaluator
body:
## Summary

Prove that unchanged PR2697 `Callback.weight` stores at most `h+1` RETURN records on its value stack. This sharpens PR2758's four-tape retained-backing allowance while keeping its source contracts and live-symbol proof:

```diff
- 2F(h) + T + B + 2
+ F(h) + (h+1)B + T + B + 2
```

Here `h>=1`, `A=2I+4`, `B=R+3`, `T=max(A,B)` and `F(h)=(h+1)T+hB`. The package also proves exact depth-zero backing, accounts for arbitrary warm history coordinatewise, and states the conditional `A>=B` binary-grammar sharpness boundary.

For the already published GL64 depth-two example, the certified allowance drops from 340 to 214 cells, matching its known observation. The new result is the all-depth source lemma and per-tape rejection checks, not a new measurement or runtime saving.

Scientific source: Jose Manuel/jmbarrancoml's #2697 at `a53fdf4bcbe33c6732f0bec1badc8c023380f9d1`, authenticated through Nick Petalas's unchanged #2758 exports. Exact pins, proof, receipt, limitations and next questions are in `research/selected-continuation-backing/`. The #2770 numerical live-word result, Ross Richardson's #2831 arena backing and #2923 native ADD join retain separate credit. Source notices remain unchanged. Substantial automated assistance was used for analysis, proof drafting, implementation and internal review.

[Canonical scoped claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2319#discussioncomment-18972137). Started at current main `a7482490b`; refreshed main `3bee87dc2` has unchanged priorities, selected record, consumed inputs and replay runner. Fresh overlap covered 495 open PRs, 2,122 closed/merged PRs and 1,601 Discussion records. Metadata coverage omits arbitrary diffs and unpublished work.

## Evidence

- Before: conservative GL64 depth-two allowance 340, observed 214. After: proved allowance 214, literal lengths `145+44+19+6`.
- Registered normal/optimized Python 3.12 replay passes 524 branch histories, 914240 observed tape writes, three actual GL64 fixtures, repeated/warm histories and three real quota failures.
- Nine behavioral tests pass, including one-cell-short, retained blank arrays, bad source hashes and observer restoration after failed context entry. Optimized Python 3.14 compatibility passes.
- Research workflow suite: 144 tests pass, seven platform skips. Scoped Ruff checks/formatting, local documentation links, source pins and committed-byte preflight pass.
- Separate internal source/proof review reproduced the receipt and all nine tests. No independent human, formal-kernel or hosted-CI pass is claimed.

Replay: `python3.12 -I -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/selected-continuation-backing`.

## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: research.

One opt-in package. The theorem assumes successful private weight execution; general `B>A` optimality is open. Numerical arenas, input programs/fields, other caller categories, physical reuse/movement, complete reserve and supplier admission remain separate. The selected frontier and frozen predecessors are unchanged; no new kappa or complete multiplication theorem is claimed.
